programs.title: Trading Program
programs.tagline: Build a disciplined foundation for market participation.
programs.description: A structured learning path covering market basics, analysis frameworks, and practical application — taught as education, not signals.
whoItsFor: New learners seeking structured market education
Professionals who want a clear foundation before going deeper
Anyone tired of tip-based, unstructured content
whatYoullLearn: Core market concepts and how instruments work
Simple analysis frameworks you can practise
Journaling and review habits that build discipline
outcomes: A clear understanding of disciplined market learning
A personal study routine you can sustain
Language and frameworks to evaluate opportunities calmly

faq.question: Who is this program for?
faq.answer: Beginners and early intermediates who want structured education — not tips or guaranteed outcomes.

faq.question: Is this a signals or tips service?
faq.answer: No. This is an educational program focused on frameworks, process, and risk awareness.

faq.question: Do I need prior experience?
faq.answer: No prior trading experience is required. Curiosity and commitment to practice are enough to start.

programs.title: Options Program
programs.tagline: Understand options as a structured learning discipline.
programs.description: Education-focused options learning for informed decision-making — mechanics, risk, and thoughtful application.
whoItsFor: Learners who understand basic markets and want options literacy
Professionals who want to study options without hype
whatYoullLearn: When education says “stand aside” matters as much as “act”
outcomes: Clearer options vocabulary and risk awareness
Ability to evaluate a structure before acting

faq.question: Is this suitable for complete beginners?
faq.answer: Best after the Trading Program foundations — or equivalent market basics.

programs.title: Risk Management Program
programs.tagline: Protect capital through process and discipline.
programs.description: Frameworks for position sizing, risk control, and capital preservation — the backbone of sustainable learning.
whoItsFor: Anyone who has jumped into markets without a risk plan
Learners who want capital preservation as a core skill
whatYoullLearn: Position sizing models you can apply
How to design personal risk rules

faq.question: Will this teach me how to make guaranteed profits?
faq.answer: No. It teaches how to manage uncertainty and protect capital while you learn.

programs.title: Trading Psychology
programs.tagline: Build the mindset behind consistent learning.
programs.description: Behavioral frameworks for discipline, patience, and process adherence.

programs.title: Live Mentorship
programs.description: Mentorship-format sessions focused on education and accountability.
